suggested_fix: No security fix needed. The codec name is written with a bounded snprintf, the ACPI device is used (acpi_dev_name) before its reference is dropped with acpi_dev_put (which is NULL-safe), the loop only dereferences codecs when num_codecs is non-zero, and errors from platform-name fixup and card registration are checked. Optionally, avoid overwriting pdev->dev.driver->pm at runtime (driver ops should be static/const) as a robustness cleanup.
